title: AI Will Power Brand–Consumer Content Co-Creation and Personalized Connection
summary: Social and e-commerce content is video-first; quality and personalization decide commercial outcomes. AI drives generation, guidance, and efficiency—fusing content with business value.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / AIGC Open Day · September 20, 2023 · Theme: AI + commercial content · Guests: Kuaizi, Infimind, Chaohui AI

Social and e-commerce content is video-first; quality and personalization decide commercial outcomes. AI drives generation, guidance, and efficiency—fusing content with business value.

Companies

  • Kuaizi (筷子科技) — intelligent creative SaaS for the content commerce stack: element-deconstruction methodology + AI/cloud/creative big data; production, ops optimization, tag insight, collaboration—serving brands, internet cos, content agencies.
  • Infimind (极睿科技) (2017) — AIGC full-chain for e-commerce: shoot → layout → livestream clips → product short video; “good content → good GMV.” Tsinghua CS AI lab founders; advisors Tsinghua/RUC/MIT/Stanford/NUS; billion-RMB B from Sequoia, GSR, Turing, Moliang, Shunwei.
  • Chaohui AI (超会AI) — AI content tools for marketers + enterprise private datasets; “find customers / serve customers.” Two months: 50k users, 3,000+ paid, 200+ team customers.

Themes

Content ↔ commerce: platforms need diversified, personalized content; AI lowers production cost while raising relevance.

True customer need: not more assets for their own sake—measurable funnel lift (attention → trust → conversion).

AI in commercial practice: smart production + ops feedback loops + private data for brand voice consistency at scale.

8 CN images; attach on ingest.

— END —
